concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-subscription-node]] - Node.js subscription notification kinds with event-specific charge, activation, past-due and skipped-billing trigger qualifications, plus the 20-most-recent-transactions payload limit
warnings: Preserve the named event scope and each retained exception: unsuccessful-charge excludes manual retries and failed subscription-creation transactions; trial-to-first-cycle does not trigger went-active; went-past-due is limited to the initial declined transaction and does not repeat in that billing cycle.
Keep the skipped-billing condition tied to a negative or zero balance that covers the subscription cost; do not generalize it into a billing outcome for other balance states.
Preserve that the Subscription object contains the 20 most recent associated transactions; do not claim complete transaction history.
Do not turn notification names or trigger conditions into universal webhook delivery, ordering, retry, duplicate-handling, billing-success, or payment-finality guarantees.
Treat linked parsing, recurring-billing, balance, and Subscription-object pages as navigation only because they were not fully read for this candidate.
